name: Service Due
office_task: When a job is done, keep its equipment on our register, work out each unit's service and warranty dates from our schedule, draft reminders for us to release, and turn a yes into one booking request.
systems_of_record: the job system that issues the job_id (ServiceM8, Simpro, Fergus, Jobber or AroFlo) and the equipment register on it that issues the asset_id

emits.write: on the asset in the register: the service or warranty date worked out from the written schedule row (or the warranty term on the record) on this run, with the reminder drafted onto the morning list for a named person to release, never a stored due date
emits.readback: reading the asset back by its asset_id returns its history with the drafted entry, the derived date and the schedule row that produced it; no entry on the read means nothing was written and the run raises an exception

emits.write: one booking request in the job system after a customer's yes, against that customer and asset, carrying their reply word for word, with no time and no price; the office is told its job number to book and price it
emits.readback: the job system returns the job number and reading that job back returns the same asset_id and customer; the open jobs for the asset are read before every write, so a second yes or a second run finds the first request and writes nothing

emits.write: an exception on the asset naming the person who owns it: a missing install date, model or equipment type, an equipment type with no schedule row, a customer who agreed to neither SMS nor email, a reply that is not a yes or a stop, or a write that did not read back
emits.readback: the exception desk returns an exception_id, and reading the asset back shows it open with its kind; an open exception stops every reminder for that asset until the named person clears it
